description: This file defines the 'FieldToList' class, which implements a mini-language operation for converting a field value into a list within the OFBiz framework's mini language. It provides functionality to add a specific field's value to a list stored in the environment map during method execution, and includes a factory class for creating instances from XML elements.

classes.name: FieldToList
classes.description: Represents a mini-language operation that appends a field value to a list in the environment map.

classes.name: FieldToList.FieldToListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToList from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, retrieving a field value and adding it to the specified list in the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation for debugging.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Creates a new instance of FieldToList from an XML element and the current simple method context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the factory, used in configuration.
